oracle:
"""A digest whose name is not a real day means the archive was only partly interpreted.

scan_digests is the one place that turns files on disk into days. If a file matches the digest name
shape but names a day that does not exist, the enumeration is incomplete: something wrote a name
this tool does not understand, and the set of days it did understand is not trustworthy. Dropping it
lets a partly interpreted archive print COMPLETE, which is the verdict the scanner exists to make
impossible.
"""
import pytest

import completeness as C


def _write(arch, name, body="# synthetic digest\n"):
    p = arch / "digests" / name[:4]
    p.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (p / (name + ".md")).write_text(body, encoding="utf-8")


def test_a_name_that_is_not_a_real_day_is_not_silently_dropped(tmp_path):
    arch = tmp_path / "archive"
    _write(arch, "2026-07-14")
    _write(arch, "2026-02-30")          # right shape, no such calendar day

    with pytest.raises(C.CannotCheck):
        C.scan_digests(arch)

    rc = C.main(["--archive-dir", str(arch), "--start", "2026-07-14", "--end", "2026-07-14"])
    assert rc == C.EXIT_CANNOT_CHECK, (
        "an archive holding a digest name this tool cannot interpret returned %s; only 2 is honest "
        "here, because the enumeration did not finish" % rc)


def test_the_refusal_is_not_always_on(tmp_path):
    """Positive control: an archive of well formed names still scans and still says COMPLETE."""
    arch = tmp_path / "clean-archive"
    _write(arch, "2026-07-14")
    _write(arch, "2026-07-15")
    present, empty = C.scan_digests(arch)
    assert len(present) == 2 and empty == []
    rc = C.main(["--archive-dir", str(arch), "--start", "2026-07-14", "--end", "2026-07-15"])
    assert rc == C.EXIT_COMPLETE, "the control archive did not scan clean, got %s" % rc
